title: Valid Survey Simulations with Limited Human Data: The Roles of Prompting, Fine-Tuning, and Rectification
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical accuracy of LLM-simulated surveys across domains like nutrition, economics, and politics. While it includes standard 'Ethical considerations' and 'Limitations' sections and analyzes demographic bias (gender, race, income), it does not evaluate or benchmark moral reasoning, religious topics, or ethical frameworks.
